notes: Formerly NTUC Income; the site and PDFs now use Income Insurance (some customer testimonials still say NTUC Income).

Left out as closed or withdrawn: Care Secure and PrimeShield (withdrawn from new policies 9 Sep 2025), IncomeShield (no longer open to new applications since 2013), Managed Healthcare System and its Outpatient Plan (no longer available for new applications), and the Deluxe Care, Classic Care, Plus and Assist IP riders (withdrawn 1 Apr 2026).

Left out: Gro Capital Ease (page only says register interest for next launch), Co-Pay Assist Plan (group policy for public service employees), Corporatised Entities Group Insurance Scheme (employee scheme), and group and commercial pages.
Integrated Shield Plans for Public Officers is a discounted-premium channel for Enhanced IncomeShield and IncomeShield Standard Plan, not listed separately.
Optima Care and Essential Care riders have no page of their own; they are described on the Enhanced IncomeShield page and have policy-conditions PDFs.
DIRECT Star Term has a separate page for the renewable variant (life-insurance/direct-star-term-(renewable)); listed once. Its product summaries cover both variants.
Gro Annuity Pro page says it is for policyholders who want to exercise the annuity option in their policies (immediate annuity only).
Affinity plans (HomeTeamNS, LUV, SAFRA, OCBC Protect) are individually bought by members or cardholders; channel marked unknown/bank because the pages do not say more.
Channel values are inferred from the page buttons: Buy now, Talk to us, and the DIRECT-only statement.
Enhanced IncomeShield page announces benefit changes from 1 Oct 2026 (new $500 annual outpatient deductible).
Solitaire-series pages exist under both /solitaire/ and /savings-and-investments/ or /life-insurance/; the latter URLs are used.
PDFs are hosted on Income CDN assets-au-01.kc-usercontent.com, linked from the product pages.
